Name: Looking For Love Redux
Author: mushroomhash
Description:
[center][center][size=5]﻿hello! this is my first conte﻿nt patcher mod, so there its definitely going to have some bugs...please let me know if you encounter any issues!
[/size]



[i][size=3]did you ever wish that you romance the older residents of Pelican Town? [/size]
[size=4]if so, then this is the mod for you[/size][/i][size=4]! [/size][size=4] ( •̀ ω •́ )✧
[/size]
[size=5]✧✧✧[/size]

[color=#dbb0a7]
[/color][i][size=5][color=#dbb0a7]this makes The Wizard, Lewis, Gus, Clint, Marnie, Pam, Sandy, Willy, and Linus romancible!
[/color]not only that, but can also change their sprites and portraits to make them look younger or to your liking!
[/size][/i][i][size=5]
[/size][/i][size=5]✧✧✧[/size]
[b][size=6][color=#e06666]
 the original code was written by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48380238]foggywizard[/url], i just rewrote most of it to make it compatible with the new update! ﻿(yes, i did get permission to post it)[/color]
[/size][/b]

[size=4]to use, unzip the file and place it into your mods folder! that's it! 

[/size]if you have any of the ﻿Romanceable Rasmodius variants (i recommend you use one of those for now honestly), then you can uncheck Wizard as datable in the config via ﻿Generic Mod Config Menu (recommended) or the config file in the mod folder

to change any of the included character's sprites, go to﻿ Mods\Looking for Love\[CP] Looking for Love\assets\Characters
there are two options for each NPC: ﻿Update[npc name] and Vanilla[npc name]
if you have a custom sprite (one that didn't come with the mod) rename it to either one of the options (so for Linus it would either be UpdateLinus or VanillaLinus) and replace the original one with the new and renamed one
then go to the config using either of the methods mentioned above and either check VanillaSprite or UpdateSprite according to the new one you put in the folder (so if you want to use Linus's updated sprite, or put a custom one you named UpdateLinus, then you would check the UpdateSprite for his name in GMCM, or in the file itself it would be: ﻿"LinusOptions": "UpdateSprite")

it is the same process for their portraits, just that they are in Mods\Looking for Love\[CP] Looking for Love\assets\Portraits
the two options are the same, and to use either one you would check UpdatePort or VanillaPort for the NPC or in the config file you would type out UpdatePort or VanillaPort for the NPC (for example, if you wanted to use Linus's vanilla port, or a custom one that you renamed VanillaLinus, then it would look like this :"LinusOptions":  VanillaPort")

if you have another mod that changes any of the affected npcs sprites or portraits, and you prefer that one, then uncheck all the Sprites (Update and Vanilla) or Portraits (Update and Vanilla) for the character in GMCM or in the file leave remove it from the character's line (so if you have a mod that changes the Wizard's sprite, but you want this mod to change its portrait, then it would be like this:  "WizardOptions": "(Vanilla/Update)Port and vice versa if you want this mod to change his sprite but not the portrait: ﻿"WizardOptions": "(Vanilla/Update)Sprite if you don't want this mod to change both of the Wizard's portrait and sprite then leave it blank like this "WizardOptions": "")[/center][center]
please go check out the original mod when you have the chance!
[size=3]also, please remember this is just an update to the original mod, so all the new stuff from 1.6 isn't included in this mod yet (festivals, winter sprites, etc.)[/size]
[size=5]✧✧✧
[/size][size=4]KNOWN ISSUES[/size]

[list]
[*][s]NPCS don't show up at festivals (im working on this right now, stay tuned)[/s] FIXED in the next update
[*]mod patches the winter sprites and portraits (working on adding them to the mod, for now if you want to see the winter sprites uncheck the Vanilla/Updated sprites for the NPCs in the config)
[*]mod doesn't patch the new festivals (WIP)
[*][s]Schedule and Event issues with Sandy and the Wizard (WIP)[/s] FIXED
[/list]please let me know if there any bugs or issues in the bugs column so that its easier for me to go through them!
